name: Edge Glide
summary: A phone travel guide where you swipe in from the edge and a soft blob stretches out to take you back
about: A three-level travel guide for Pakistan that moves like a real phone: places, then a city, then one sight, each page sliding in over the last with layered hills drifting at different speeds. Pull in from the left edge and a gooey blob grows under your finger while its little chevron turns into a bold arrow once you pass the line. Let go and the page glides away with your fling while the blob wobbles back; pull from the right edge to go forward again.
how: Tap a place card, then a sight, to go deeper; the old page slides left and dims behind the new one.
Drag in from the left edge to go back: the blob follows your finger, the page peeks open and a tick marks the point of no return.
Let go before the line and everything springs back; flick fast and it goes back even on a short pull.
Drag in from the right edge to return to the page you just left, and use the filter chips, the heart and Add to trip on the way.
Keyboard: Tab to any card or button, Enter opens it, Escape or Alt + Left goes back and Alt + Right goes forward.
